response.text: {"question":"If a firm deals with products that would fall under PROD chapters after those chapters became effective, can it decide whether to follow the PROD processes or the PRIN 2A.3 processes?","answer":"Yes. When a firm either handles such products or is subject to PROD 1.3.2R, it may elect to apply either the relevant PROD chapter procedures (PROD 3 for financial instruments and structured deposits, PROD 4 for insurance) or the procedures set out in PRIN 2A.3.","answerable":true}
